intro.summary: A Rongmei Christian song collection digitized from the supplied Khristian Luzaam PDF and legacy hymn database.
intro.description: This edition combines 250 song pages transcribed from the supplied PDF (printed numbers 1–257, with seven numbers absent from the supplied file) and 44 additional SQLite records that did not have a high-confidence match to the PDF. The DB-only records retain their legacy record numbers; some unusual source placeholders or spellings may still need proofreading.

credits.compiledBy: Digitized from the supplied Khristian Luzaam PDF and hymnal_1_2_3.db; partial editorial review
credits.publisher: Original publication details not yet verified
credits.rights: Song text and source-book rights remain with their respective authors, translators, compilers, publishers, and rights holders. This digital transcription does not change ownership.

changelog.note: Added the Ngai Luzaam collection page and an initial four-song Christmas-season transcription. More songs remain to be digitized and checked.
Added Bethlehem, Noel, and seasonal worship selections from printed song numbers 254–256. The online edition remains a partial transcription.

Compared the PDF song pages against the 200-row SQLite collection, imported all 250 available PDF song pages, and added 44 unmatched legacy database records. Seven printed numbers (179, 215, 218–222) are absent from the supplied PDF.
